purpose: Per-figure data trace for /admin/analytics. Every number rendered on the dashboard maps to exactly one source below. Update this file when adding a new metric.

overview.filter: channel=meta_ads AND metric=spend_usd AND date IN [range]

acquisition.rules: paid: cpc OR paid_social OR paidsocial OR paid OR ads; organic: organic OR referral OR seo; other: everything else

behavior.estimation: Per-milestone distribution estimated as 45/28/17/10% of aggregate. Will be replaced with direct percent_scrolled dimension query once the param-level breakdown is added to getGA4Summary.

funnel.note: One card per platform. Never summed across platforms. GBP four impression surfaces are slices of one location and may be summed with each other.

funnel.filter: channel=gbp AND metric IN desktop/mobile maps+search impressions

funnel.reason: TikTok writes cumulative video views, not daily impressions

funnel.note: Consent-gated. Caption only. First-party visitor_sessions is the visit spine.

funnel.filter: event_type=join_convert AND event_at IN [range], fleet-test dropped

funnel.note: Recruit view uses consumer (non-recruit) attributable leads as the book a recruit joins. Seller/buyer view splits that audience.

funnel.filter: visited AND (crm_person_id IS NOT NULL OR identified_at IS NOT NULL)
created_at IN [range] AND deleted=false AND attributable AND personAppearsInAudience
kind IN call,voicemail,sms_out,sms_in,email_out,appointment AND source != sequence, after lead created_at. Phone/text doors count as working immediately.
pipeline=Sellers AND stage IN (Listed, Offer, Pending, Closed) AND person_id IN lead cohort

funnel.note: First recorded source. Farm/Import/Sphere excluded. Manual tagged.

funnel.filter: pipeline=Sellers AND stage IN (Listed, Offer, Pending, Closed)

conversions.filter: created_at IN [range] AND deleted=false AND attributable
created_at IN [range] AND deleted=false AND attributable
created_at IN [range] AND deleted=false AND attributable
leads: crm_people created_at IN [range] AND attributable; sessions: channel=ga4 AND scope=account AND metric=sessions AND date IN [range]

conversions.formula: SUM(marketing_channel_daily.value WHERE channel=meta_ads AND metric=spend_usd) / crm_people inbound lead count

notes: GA4 Data API is queried live on every page render — no caching layer. If GA4 is slow, the page is slow. Future iteration: pull from public.marketing_channel_daily as a read-replica with a 'live GA4' toggle.

LEAD_EVENT_NAMES is defined in app/actions/ga4-report.ts: generate_lead, contact_agent, contact_agent_click, schedule_tour_click, tour_requested, valuation_requested, cma_downloaded, sign_up, newsletter_signup.
Per-figure double-check: open the GA4 UI for the same date range, run the same dimension+metric combo, compare totals. They should match within rounding.

Brand voice: numbers are surfaced as integers with thousand separators (formatInt), percentages with one decimal and a percent sign (formatPct), durations as Nm Ns (formatDuration), currency rounded to the nearest dollar (formatUsd).
